gen-almendra-display-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Ornate and bookish up top, Almendra Display keeps its letters from ever pinching shut. And Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits below it, a sans with clipped capitals and wide-spaced, breathing counters.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-bhutuka-expand: BhuTuka Expanded One reads slowly, a serif with curvy letters and joins as sturdy as its stems. Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with daylight in every curve, while the body font settles into its leisurely, literary pace.
gen-archivo-black-gf-marcellus-sc: Archivo Black hits hard, with a tall middle and plenty of room around each shape. Marcellus SC settles beneath it in gentle, finely modulated serif strokes, so the dense heading gets a dignified, lighter counterweight.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-montaga: Oswald packs its rows of text tightly and speaks with a confident, strong voice at the top of the page. Montaga answers more softly, with curves that feel stitched by thread.
gen-almendra-display-gf-atkinson-hyperle: Literary in spirit, Almendra Display opens every letter wide and lifts a pronounced x-height into its headings. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next is the plain sans with big, unlatched rounds.
gen-archivo-black-gf-montagu-slab: Heavy, urban and sure of itself, Archivo Black fills the line's middle while Montagu Slab slips in beneath with gentler strokes. Their strongest trait is how a blunt heading meets a refined, traditional body.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-fs-spline-sans: Marker-bold and sunlit, Red Hat Display draws a constant-width line with daylight inside every curve. Spline Sans follows in a sans with wide gaps at the curve ends, and its body text looks best a size or two under the heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-new-tegomin: Oswald's tightly knit rows give the heading a confident, strong grip, and nothing about it feels loose. New Tegomin, a text serif with wide-open ring-like c shapes, feels dignified beside it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-biryani: Almendra Display never pinches a letter shut. It carries the ornate, literary flourish, while Biryani, a sans with large-eyed e shapes and uniform strokes, does the quiet, approachable work of plain reading.
gen-archivo-black-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Broad, loud and urban, Archivo Black fills the middle of each line with weight. But Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps a refined, traditional pace beneath it, its open curves and tall small letters carrying a long page with ease.
